### engUnit and formatString Writer

This utility is for setting the engineering units and the format string for UDT Atomic Tags for display. 

1. Browse to the UDT definition that is being changed. 
1. The tool will try to put some in for you.
   1. Greyed out units are what is there already, The input box will be written to the engUnit property.
1. Input the changes necessary on the top right input boxes. 
1. Click on 'Add Tags' to stage the changes to write.
1. Click 'Write Changes' and confirm. 
1. When changes are written, an Export Changes button will appear.
   1. Click the button to open a popup with a table of all changes written in the current perspective session. The table includes the tagpath written to, the old value, the new value, and the returned result from the writeBlocking command.
   1. The button on the popup will download the table to a .csv file and clear the table.
